version:    1.0.0

changelog:
  1.0.0   2026-09-03  init         First versioned stamp. Restored to its original, pre-existing shape (Context=on-dark axis, slotted Button v1, tight MIN-aligned .content layout) after a same-session experiment altered it in place — this component turned out to be live in an external file's homepage carousel, so the in-place edit was reverted rather than risk breaking that usage. Status set to deprecated: "QuoteCard — v2" (2.0.0) is the version for new work; this v1 is kept fully functional for existing consumers only. Do not use in new work.

Full-bleed quote card for social proof carousels. Desktop (1480×824) — landscape carousel slide. Mobile (375×620) — portrait and narrow contexts. Swap Media to control aspect ratio or use video. Toggle Show CTA, Show Attribution, and Show Pagination to simplify the card.
